gbm_population_evidence.quote: Lenvatinib, Pembrolizumab, and Tumor Treating Fields (TTFields) for Second-line Treatment of Glioblastoma
Males and females at least 18 years of age on the day of signing informed consent with histopathologic evidence of GBM (from original or recurrent diagnosis) and MRI-confirmed diagnosis of rGBM.

candidate_evidence.quote: to assess the effectiveness of pembrolizumab and lenvatinib combination therapy for recurrent glioblastoma (rGBM) patients wearing TTFields electrodes.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: with confirmed GBM progressed after first-line treatment.

role_evidence.quote: participants will be treated with TTFields (200 kHz) + intravenous pembrolizumab 200 mg every three weeks and oral lenvatinib 20 mg once daily

agents.drug_class_hint: multi-kinase (VEGFR/FGFR) inhibitor, approved in thyroid, renal, hepatocellular and endometrial cancer

role_evidence.quote: participants will be treated with TTFields (200 kHz) + intravenous pembrolizumab 200 mg every three weeks and oral lenvatinib 20 mg once daily

coder_notes: Single-arm phase 1/2 in recurrent GBM; pembrolizumab and lenvatinib both investigational in the arm (experimental_combination each). TTFields is a device (not an agent); it is part of the experimental arm and some patients may already wear it from first line, but it is not an antitumour drug. Pembrolizumab is not device_dependent (TTFields is not used for delivery/activation). Archival tissue submission is required but no molecular biomarker is named.
